sub_strands.name: Geometric Scale and Design Matrices
performance_indicators: Apply geometric scaling rules to enlarge or reduce 2D and 3D architectural/artistic models proportionally.
Solve scheduling, budgeting, and resource constraint equations using basic linear optimization models.

sub_strands.name: Anatomical Drawing and Industrial Styling
performance_indicators: Produce human figure drawings showing accurate skeletal anatomy, muscle volume, and foreshortening.
Create corporate branding packages, including vector logotypes, typography guidelines, and structural layouts.
Execute complex multi-color textile prints using advanced screen-printing and emulsion processing techniques.

sub_strands.name: African Art Traditions and Contemporary Movements
performance_indicators: Analyze the symbolic meaning, materials, and functions of traditional African pottery, masks, and rock art.
Evaluate contemporary East African modern art trends using formal aesthetic criticism parameters.

sub_strands.name: Harmonic Progression and Digital Orchestration
performance_indicators: Write four-part harmonic progressions using primary chords ($I, IV, V, V7$) in root position and inversions.
Sequence an original short composition using Digital Audio Workstation (DAW) software tools.

sub_strands.name: Play Directing, Set Design, and Dance
performance_indicators: Block and direct a dramatic scene, managing character staging, spatial dynamics, and vocal inflection.
Design miniature stage set layouts incorporating lighting scripts, soundscapes, and period-accurate costuming.
Choreograph a contemporary dance routine integrating traditional ethnic rhythms with modern spatial flows.

sub_strands.name: Musculoskeletal System and Motion Forces
performance_indicators: Identify major muscle groups and bone structures involved in specific athletic movements.
Analyze sports techniques (e.g., high-jump clearance, football strike) using levers, center of gravity, and force vectors.
Design targeted strength, flexibility, and cardiovascular conditioning programs for specific athletic goals.

sub_strands.name: Officiating Systems and Exercise Injury Treatment
performance_indicators: Apply complex regulatory rules and structural officiating systems to manage competitive sports matches.
Demonstrate soft-tissue athletic injury management procedures following standard PRICE protocols.

sub_strands.name: Scriptwriting and Creative Reviews
performance_indicators: Compose original dramatic scripts, radio screenplays, and performance poetry pieces.
Write critical reviews of fine art exhibitions, theatrical plays, or musical performances using standard terminology.

sub_strands.name: Uandishi wa Tamthilia na Uhakiki wa Sanaa
performance_indicators: Kuandika michezo mifupi ya kuigiza na mashairi ya kizazi kipya yanayohusu masuala ibuka.
Kuhakiki maonyesho ya sanaa, nyimbo, au michezo ya jukwaani kwa kutumia lugha sanifu ya kisanii.
